newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Oct Oman crude trades at MPM less 50 cents/barrel.
newsitem.headline: Oct Oman crude trades at MPM less 50 cents/barrel.

text.p: A 500,000-barrel cargo of Oman crude for October lifting has been traded between a national oil company and a major at MPM minus 50 cents per barrel, trade sources said on Friday.
The marketing of Oman has already moved to November barrels but there was an overhang of four to five cargos of October lifting Oman crude, which put prices under pressure.

The overhang had already pushed the price of October Oman down to MPM less 11.5 cents, based on the last October Oman deal done, and prompted term contract buyers to call for a sharp cut in the MPM for September, which is due to be announced by Oman
The latest trade was carried out on Friday.
November cargoes of the crude are trading in a range of November Dubai quotes plus 81 to 84 cents, which traders have estimated is around MPM minus 15 cents.
Two majors exchanged November Oman on Thursday at MPM minus two cents, traders said.
